blurb: Hy-Line Cruises operates high-speed passenger ferries and local cruises including Cape Cod Canal Cruises. They provide seasonal and year-round ferry services to Nantucket and Martha's Vineyard, as well as inter-island ferry service. Amenities include indoor and outdoor seating, snack bars, and pet-friendly policies on most ferries.
